title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-mbm7: window bit position mismatch in Ack write_to complete path
description: In fragment.rs, Ack::write_to line 225: `out[1] = (self.window << 7) | 0x40` puts window at bit 7, but Ack::from_bytes_for line 263: `(data[1] >> FRAGMENT_N) & 1` reads window from bit 6 (FRAGMENT_N=6). A round-trip window=0->serialize->deserialize yields window=1 because 0x40 sets bit 6. The serialize path must use FRAGMENT_N consistently, or the deserialize path must handle bit 7 for complete ACKs.
